title: Ways to Get On the Water

# There are So Many Ways to Get Out On the Water!

The Center for Wooden Boats aims to build a community that provides equitable access to empowering maritime experiences, and offers several ways for anyone interested to get on the water.

### [Free Programs](https://www.cwb.org/free-programs)
Free one-hour rentals of peapod rowboats for anyone who wants to get on the water.

### [Sailing Lessons](https://www.cwb.org/adult-sailing)
Adults and families learn to sail together through our signature sailing programs.

### [Rent a Boat](https://www.cwb.org/rent)
Our rental fleet includes classic wooden sailboats, canoes, kayaks, stand-up paddleboards, and rowboats. Yearly passes are available.

### [Charter Cruises](https://www.cwb.org/charters)
A 90-minute cruise aboard one of our historical vessels.
